q: When does Oboro no Ichi release?
a: Steam’s release_date field on 7 November 2026 is 9 Nov 2026, with coming_soon true. The store page calls that the planned Early Access unlock. The same page showed no user reviews.

q: Who develops and publishes Oboro no Ichi?
a: The Steam appdetails payload lists TheLaba as both developer and publisher. In the Early Access questionnaire TheLaba describes the project as the work of a solo developer. This wiki is not affiliated with TheLaba, or with Valve.

q: What kind of game is Oboro no Ichi?
a: Steam’s short description says you build and manage a spiritual market inspired by Japan, welcome wandering spirits, produce and sell resources, and grow the space through memories and a cozy atmosphere. Genres are Casual, Indie, Simulation, and Early Access. The only player category is Single-player.

q: Is there a redeem code page?
a: No. The English Steam store page and the 13 May 2026 community announcement do not publish a redeem-code program. This site does not invent codes, and it does not have a codes page.

q: Can I play Oboro no Ichi on Mac or Linux?
a: The full game’s platforms field on 7 November 2026 lists Windows and macOS, and Linux false. Windows minimum is Windows 10 64-bit, 4 GB RAM, and 5 GB of disk. macOS minimum is macOS 12 Monterey on an Apple M1, 8 GB RAM, and 5 GB of disk. The demo’s own platforms field lists Windows only.
